headline: At your 3-month check, your doctor said the stiffness and swelling in both hands could be rheumatoid arthritis and ordered blood tests, hand X-rays, and an urgent rheumatology referral.

followUps.title: Get your blood tests
followUps.detail: Go to the lab downstairs. You do not need to fast. The tests include rheumatoid factor, anti-CCP antibodies, inflammation markers, a blood count, and kidney and liver tests.

followUps.title: Get X-rays of both hands
followUps.detail: Go to the X-ray department downstairs.

followUps.title: Arrange your rheumatology visit
followUps.detail: Your doctor is making an urgent referral. No appointment was booked during the visit.

followUps.title: Pick up your Ramipril
followUps.detail: Your doctor said the prescription with refills would be sent to Elm Street Pharmacy on September 10. Sam can go over it with you when you pick it up.

followUps.title: Book a follow-up with your doctor
followUps.detail: Book the visit for after you have seen rheumatology.
followUps.when: In about 4 weeks (around October 8), after your rheumatology visit

instructions.text: Keep using acetaminophen for pain. Take up to two 500 mg tablets at a time, up to 3 times a day. Do not take more than 3,000 mg in a day.
Soak your hands in warm water in the morning to help with stiffness.
Call your doctor sooner if a joint becomes hot and very swollen or if you get a fever. Do not wait for the blood test results call.

unchanged.text: You did not start any new medicine for your hands at this visit.
Keep taking Ramipril 10 mg every morning.
Keep taking amlodipine 5 mg at night.
Keep taking atorvastatin 20 mg at night.
Keep taking lansoprazole 30 mg before breakfast.
Keep taking vitamin D 1,000 units a day.

openQuestions.text: Do you have rheumatoid arthritis or another type of inflammatory arthritis?
openQuestions.resolvesWhen: Your doctor ordered blood tests and hand X-rays and referred you to rheumatology to look into this.

openQuestions.text: What do your blood tests show?
openQuestions.resolvesWhen: Your doctor said you would get a call when the results are back, in 3 or 4 days (September 13 or 14).

openQuestions.text: Will you need a stronger medicine for inflammation or a longer-term arthritis medicine? Methotrexate was mentioned as an example, not prescribed.
openQuestions.resolvesWhen: The rheumatologist will decide with you.

openQuestions.text: Will your lansoprazole dose be lowered this fall?
openQuestions.resolvesWhen: Your doctor wants to wait until after the rheumatology visit.
